query: select l.id as lesson_id, l.title as lesson_title, s.name as series_name, l.is_active as lesson_is_active, length(coalesce(l.content, '')) as content_length, c.title as chapter_title, (select count(*) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id = l.id) as exercise_count, (select count(*) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id = l.id and e.is_active = false and e.is_published = false) as draft_exercise_count, (select count(*) from public.exercise_questions eq join public.exercises e on e.id = eq.exercise_id where e.lesson_id = l.id) as exercise_question_count, (select count(*) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id = l.id) as quiz_count, (select count(*) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id = l.id and q.is_active = false and q.is_published = false) as draft_quiz_count, (select count(*) from public.quiz_questions qq join public.quizzes q on q.id = qq.quiz_id where q.lesson_id = l.id) as quiz_question_count from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id = l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id = c.subject_offering_id join public.series s on s.id = o.series_id where l.id in ('6f0225cd-37bd-40b1-a724-81d1a3f559d9','6a25851a-22e4-4f8a-bfe9-2b5ca620ca54','7b216e2b-b10f-45be-90f9-f55bb92a1849','9d35557a-cbb0-4fd6-8e0b-21c8e68d059c','5ed46281-9e01-49fc-b040-5a9c04be470d','a3816920-f1ea-4f3c-a29a-aee9dcdbaa02','0cf780b6-fca8-46ed-bfdf-4b2c86809459','40e08dfd-1889-4965-aeeb-04dcdd3544d1') order by l.title, s.name limit 8;
